topic: unknown-rank Hankel/CUR from raw HMM trajectories

input_interface.trajectory_length: B burn-in symbols discarded plus L retained symbols

process_class.mixing_bound: Dobrushin coefficient <= rho=1-alpha; burn-in bias <= rho^B
process_class.coherence: left and right singular-space coherence <= supplied mu_0

proved_claims.statement: For D_L=sum_(h=0)^L a^h unique word events, eta=sqrt(log(2D_L/delta_e)/(2N))+rho^B uniformly bounds all empirical word probabilities with probability >=1-delta_e.

Uniform row/column sampling at s_R,s_C=O(mu_0 R log(R/delta_s)) captures the finite Hankel singular spaces with probability >=1-delta_s; a core cutoff at 2 epsilon_W recovers unknown r when kappa_0=lambda_0 sqrt(s_R s_C)/(2 sqrt(pq)) >=4 epsilon_W.
Under stated entry, core, and product precision budgets, ||H_hat_CUR-H||_op <= epsilon, hence each finite block word probability error is <=epsilon.
For epsilon<=lambda_0/4, finite-block left and right singular subspaces have sine-angle operator error <=2 epsilon/lambda_0.
For k-symbol contexts, positive emissions and epsilon<=min(nu^k/2,nu^k/(8a)) yield one-step finite-context next-symbol total-variation error <=4a epsilon/nu^k.

Each raw path supplies the prefix indicators for all words through length L; any CUR procedure on these data is postprocessing of the same observations. The full-data baseline can simulate it, so CUR has no information or trajectory-sample advantage under identical paths.

Within a stationary positive mixing two-state binary HMM family with fixed transition/emission lower bounds, ranks 1 and 2 can be made arbitrarily close in length-L raw-path total variation; with contrast z=1/(10NL), N-episode exact-rank testing error is at least 0.45.

costs.burn_in: B >= ceil(log(2/eta_*)/(-log rho)) when 0<rho<1; B=1 suffices for rho=0 unless exact stationary reset gives B=0
costs.numerical_precision: Certified absolute zeta_W and zeta_CUR budgets; counts are exact rationals

matched_baseline: Same raw paths: all D_L prefix-word counts, full empirical p-by-q Hankel, full SVD, plus retained-path or count-table predictor. Same episode/reset cost; CUR can save downstream dense storage and SVD arithmetic only.
unknown_or_not_claimed: uniform exact rank recovery without a positive finite-block singular gap
finite-block coherence from positivity or mixing alone
process-valid lower bound against all coherence-adaptive algorithms
hidden-state label recovery or parameter identifiability
prediction conditional on the entire infinite past
a predictive-risk advantage over full raw-data model selection
novelty_status: Conditional application of standard matrix concentration, CUR, and perturbation results; no novelty or priority claim.
